Name: Huge Sheds
Author: bluestarkiller
Description:
[color=#e06666][size=5][b]This mod is deprecated. Please use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1662] Huge Sheds Redux[s]﻿[/s] [/url]instead[/b]
[/size][/color]
[s]

This mod will change your shed to add 4 small and one large room in the main floor, a medium attic and a [b]HUGE[/b][size=2] basement.

[/size]Only the main room can have the walls and floors redecorated, the other rooms are sadly stuck as they are. I can (if asked nicely) change the decoration of the rooms.

[size=4]To install:[/size]

-Download and install Advanced Location Loader from [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-advanced-location-loader.3619/]here.[/url] This is required or the ladder and the trapdoor won't work. If you don't install them you'll still have access to the rooms on the main floor.
-Drop the files into your Contents folder.
-Profit?



Thanks to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/681/?]JAC'd Sheds[/url] as his shed mod was the basis for this one.[/s]
